# Acceptance-Risk Requirements Checklist: Bilingual Landing Page for We Can Organization

**Purpose**: Test whether the requirements most likely to cause rework or failed acceptance are complete, clear, consistent and measurable: bilingual parity and right-to-left behavior, accessibility, responsive navigation and the menu, contact placeholders, and search/sharing metadata.
**Created**: 2026-10-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (with [plan.md](../plan.md) and [contracts](../contracts/))

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is it specified that later content changes must be made in both language versions together, or how long the two versions may differ? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, SC-003]
- [x] CHK002 Are text-direction requirements defined for every Latin-script or numeric run inside Arabic text (for example "NGO", "CBO", "© 2026", web addresses), not only the email address? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 Is a requirement defined for how screen readers identify the language switch and pronounce its label, which is written in the other language? [Gap, Spec §FR-018, FR-027]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for a page-not-found experience in both languages, or is it explicitly out of scope? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK005 Are length limits specified for the search titles and descriptions in both languages? [Gap, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK006 Are acceptance requirements defined for the post-launch Arabic review: who reviews, by when, and what counts as done? [Gap, Spec §FR-021, SC-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the required logo size specified for tablets, given that FR-013 only quantifies laptops/desktops and phones? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK008 Is "visually muted" for placeholders defined in measurable terms that still meet the 4.5:1 text contrast requirement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, FR-027]
- [x] CHK009 Is "the same section" defined for language switching when the visitor is at the hero or between two sections? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK010 Is "the section currently in view" defined for moments when two sections share the screen? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK011 Is the "representative image" for link previews specified: which image, and whether it differs by language? [Clarity, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK012 Is "typical mobile connection" in SC-005 defined with a specific network and device profile? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK013 Is the sticky header's height or behavior defined for short screens (for example phones in landscape) so it never hides most of the content? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK014 Are the registration wordings consistent: "Registered NGO / CBO in Jordan" (About badge), "Registered NGO in Jordan" (footer, FR-011) and the approved "NGO or CBO" statement (FR-003)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-003, FR-011]
- [x] CHK015 Is precedence stated for where the approved Stitch designs differ from later clarifications (Arabic name, header logo, removed helper copy)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012, FR-013, FR-020]
- [x] CHK016 Is "equivalent content" defined as equivalent meaning rather than literal translation, so that headings such as "The people behind We Can" / "الفريق المؤسس" pass the parity requirement? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-016, SC-003]
- [x] CHK017 Is the rule that placeholders are not keyboard-focusable consistent with the requirement that assistive technology announces them as unavailable? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 Do navigation labels, section headings and footer links use the same terms within each language? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, FR-011]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK019 Is the SC-001 hallway test assigned to the UAT plan with defined participants and conditions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, SC-010]
- [x] CHK020 Is the counting rule for SC-002 ("at most 2 taps or clicks") defined for phones, where opening the menu is already the first tap? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK021 Does SC-006 name a repeatable audit method and device profile so that scores are comparable between runs? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK022 Does SC-008 specify which preview checker and which messaging or social apps define a pass? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK023 Are keyboard-only requirements defined for wide screens (focus order across logo, links and language switch), not only for the menu? [Coverage, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK024 Are requirements defined for an open menu when the screen is rotated or resized past 1024 px? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK025 Are requirements defined for desktop users whose zoom level triggers the small-screen layout? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-023]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK026 Is a fallback defined for when web fonts fail to load, especially for the legibility of Arabic text? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK027 Is the expected result defined when the header mark image fails to load? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK028 Are wrapping requirements defined for long names, credentials and words on narrow screens in both languages? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-025]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK029 Are contrast requirements specified for text over photographs at every crop and screen width? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK030 Are reduced-motion requirements defined for every animated element (menu, scrolling, hover transitions)? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK031 Is the use of externally hosted fonts reconciled with "MUST NOT track visitors", given that font requests disclose visitors' IP addresses to a third party? [Conflict, Spec §FR-033, Assumption]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK032 Is the photo-permission assumption documented with who confirmed it and for which images? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK033 Is HTTPS on the custom domain documented as a launch dependency for canonical addresses and link previews? [Dependency, Spec §FR-028, FR-029]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- 2026-10-28: at the organization's explicit request, Claude evaluated every item, fixed the gaps at the source (spec.md edits plus two /speckit-clarify answers: Arabic review owner and self-hosted fonts) and marked all 33 items satisfied.
